auth_sessions_revoked_reason.name: auth_sessions_revoked_reason
auth_sessions_revoked_reason.value: ("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is null) = ("auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" is null) and ("auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" is null or "auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" in ('logout','replaced'))

devices_one_caregiver_login_uq.name: devices_one_caregiver_login_uq
devices_one_caregiver_login_uq.where: "devices"."user_id" is not null and "devices"."revoked_at" is null

devices_patient_has_token.name: devices_patient_has_token
devices_patient_has_token.value: "devices"."patient_id" is null or "devices"."token_hash" is not null

nlog_receipt_due_idx.name: nlog_receipt_due_idx
nlog_receipt_due_idx.where: "notification_log"."expo_ticket_id" is not null and "notification_log"."receipt_checked_at" is null

sv_weekdays.name: sv_weekdays
sv_weekdays.value: "schedule_versions"."pattern" <> 'weekdays' or coalesce(cardinality("schedule_versions"."days_of_week") between 1 and 7 and "schedule_versions"."days_of_week" <@ array[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]::smallint[], false)
